## Summary
- Route dashboard manager selector and QC stale-manager queries through `resolve_manager_id_column`, aliasing to `manager_id` in result frames.
- Fix daily-report fallback diff, news, and activism joins to use the resolved managers primary-key column on SQLite while preserving Postgres behavior.

Closes #1671

## Test plan
- [x] `pytest tests/test_dashboard.py tests/test_daily_report_views.py -q` — PASS (full suites)
- [x] Parametrized id/manager_id key-matrix tests for dashboard QC summary and daily-report fallback paths
- [x] Deliberate-break gate: hardcoded `m.manager_id` join restored briefly → `test_daily_report_fallback_queries_resolve_manager_primary_key[id]` FAILED → reverted
title: fix(ui): resolve SQLite manager keys across dashboard and daily report (#1671)
